item.title: 1907 vintage photograph: two men playing chess, Alfred Stieglitz
item.description: Not AI: a 1907 photograph by Alfred Stieglitz of two men playing chess in natural light and tree shadow. Early 20th-century photography, public domain, free at Mosaic.

item.title: F. Holland Day portrait by Gertrude Käsebier, 1898, pictorialist photography
item.description: Pictorialist portrait of photographer F. Holland Day by Gertrude Käsebier, 1898. Vintage black-and-white photography, public domain, free at Mosaic.

item.title: Clarence H. White pictorialist photography 1897–1923, Newark Ohio
item.description: Early pictorialist photographs by Clarence H. White: family and neighbours in Newark, Ohio, 1897–1900, and later work. He co-founded the Photo-Secession with Alfred Stieglitz and taught Dorothea Lange and Margaret Bourke-White. Public domain, free to download at Mosaic.

item.title: Not a painting: Robert Demachy gum bichromate photograph, 1906
item.description: Behind the Scenes, 1906, by French pictorialist Robert Demachy, who worked his gum bichromate prints by hand with brushes, sponges and his fingers to give them a painterly, Impressionist softness. Public domain vintage photography, free at Mosaic.
